name: SHORT-DESCRIPTION
data: The Burt Corner Sofa from the Naustro Fiera Collection embodies sartorial elegance through a series of refined details. Its design is distinguished by crisscross stitching on the headrest and armrest, complemented by double side stitching that emphasizes the perimeter. Available in a choice of fabric or leather covers, the sofa is supported by metal feet. Multiple layout options are offered, including a corner configuration, a corner with terminal, a maxi chaise, and a standard chaise. For enhanced comfort, the piece features a dual-motor seat recliner and an electric vertical-type headrest that can also be manually adjusted forward.
